en.text: Wasn't very sporting, but who cares.
They took out the Pigeon Lady!
I like the way you think tin man.
They took out the Chess Guy!
Don't get into too much trouble Paradox
They won't be happy about that.
Paradox put them right where she wants them.
They took out the Test Pilot!
That was a thing of beauty.
I was starting to get worried.
I needed the pick me up.
See you on the field, McGinnis
OK, I admit that was fairly impressive.
Aaaand that's why people wanted him dead.
I'm sure Seven will be on his best behavior
Glad I'm not working against her…
Now there's a lady who knows how to murder people.
How did you even see them?
Excited to see you work Vindicta
You have a great future in arson, Infernus.
Cutting it a little close, aren't we, Kelvin?
Ill be back when I can Kelvin
At least the oaf has talent.
I see that arthritis hasn’t kicked in yet.
You haven't lost a step, old man….
They took out the Rat King!
I see why Wesley chose him.
Looks like Shiv has promise after all.
Shiv can't do this on his own!
I have my eyes on you Fathom
I'll be with you soon Ivy
We make a good team, Ivy.
Ivy, you can work with me whenever you'd like.
Try not to get yourself killed Viper
I'll be back when I can, Viscous
They actually thought they could get away, didn't they?
We will NOT lose to people like them!
How are we screwing this up?
Can't forget to upgrade my powers.
It's time to augment my abilities.
I need to find a place to train.
I may want to get back to the group…
If I'm going to go out on my own I need to keep my wits about me.
They could be coming for me any minute now…
That could have been a calamity.
Better people have tried to kill me.
This wouldn't even make my top 5 near death experiences.
They're being a little frisky, aren't they?
The day people stop trying to kill you is the day you lose relevance
How didn't I account for this…
Stay focused on the task at hand…
I won't give up to the likes of them…
We can't give them the satisfaction…
If we don't change things up we could be done for…
We can get through this if we keep our wits about us.
We can't afford any more mistakes
Nice to work with competent people
Now that was quite lovely, wasn't it…
I'm the one in control here…
I'll take you down with me…
I'll put them in the dirt.
I'll give it everything I have…
I have to make this count…
I'm not dying without a fight….
I have a few tricks left.
This won't be as easy as you think…
I need to get outta here…
All you did was make yourself a stationary target.
You didn't think that would work, did you?
You need to do better, Paradox.
Paradox thought she was so smart…
He's looking for a black hole.
I'll break all of your machines, McGinnis.
I'm not worried about Fairfax Industries' little toys.
Keep planting your turrets, McGinnis, I'll keep destroying them.
Be careful, they have the Rejuvenator.
Of course I did that on purpose…
Vindicta's trying to pick us off!
She thought she was untouchable, didn't she…
You were never going to escape me, Kelvin.
I'm sure he'll be stewing over that.
Of course she flew away, why wouldn't she?
This is rather delightful, isn't it?
Of course my plan's working, I came up with it…
See how well things go when you listen to me?
This is easier than I thought it'd be.
I really am great, aren't I…
I don't have an ego, I'm just honest: It's not my fault I'm amazing.
It's nice to have good help.
I could do this all day.
If you can't stop me what chance do you have against The Troubadour?
You should have stayed in whatever backwater town you came from.
Holliday, your grandfather would be rolling in his grave.
You weren't ready for this fight, Holliday.
A smalltown sheriff couldn’t accomplish what Scotland Yard has been trying to do for years, surprise surprise.
Abrams, you picked a fight you never were going to win.
You're stronger than me… but you're not better than me.
I expected that to be tougher….
The scrap golem is no more.
We don't need to worry about Bebop.
Keep your hooks off my friends…
Your creator should have built a more competent son.
It's a shame, Ava liked you too.
You never had a chance against me, Paige.
You have a cute little parlor trick, but I'm afraid that it doesn't amount to much in a real fight.
She had no idea what she was in for, did she?
I've always wanted to go toe-to-toe with Paradox.
Love your museums by the way.
I was hoping that our paths would never cross, Paradox.
Next time, just stay out of my way.
You shouldn't have provoked me, Paradox.
I don't care if he tried to kill me, The Baroness is still the best hotel in Manhattan.
Your nature doesn't scare me, Doorman.
Perhaps I should cancel my brunch reservation.
He's a professional, I'm sure he understands.
You can take the girl out of the Baxter Society…
Well look at me living up to the Society's ideals.
You tried, Professor, that has to count for something.
Academics always think they're more important than they are.
A thousand travel books aren't worth one real trip, Dynamo… you never had a chance.
We have nothing to fear from Dynamo.
I took care of the Professor.
It’s ok, Ava, the mean little bird child won't eat you.
No one looking that cute is innocent.
I think he got the message.
That's what you get for stepping out of your ivory tower.
Your father can't protect you here, Apollo.
Well, that will garner some unwanted attention.
Did you see that, Ava? Mommy killed a prince.
I hate that I killed a royal for free.
Fairfax Industries needs a new engineer.
You're brilliant, McGinnis, but brilliance will only get you so far.
You rely on machines when you should be relying on yourself.
I'm not scared of a dead man.
Yes, yes, you're dead with no memory, it's tragic. Get on with your life, Victor.
You don't need to be so melodramatic, Victor.
Given her condition, I did that lady a favor…
Only a fool would make a deal with Oathkeeper.
I can still smell her arrogance.
There's few things worse than someone vastly overestimating their relevance.
Lady Geist isn't a problem anymore…
You're brilliant, Seven, but you're not me.
I won't lie, I'm a little disappointed.
I expected more from someone like you, Seven.
For someone who fashions themselves a mastermind you were remarkably easy to kill.
You aren't the first person who's tried to kill me, Haze.
The OSIC needs to stay out of my affairs.
The assassin has been dealt with.
It would seem that your talents are overblown.
She was more dangerous than I expected.
She had talent, she's just not me.
Snipers are the wine coolers of assassins.
Did the mean man burn you, Ava?
You're a clever man, Kelvin, why did you think you could beat me?
Your expedition has come to an end, Kelvin.
The bravest men are often the most stupid.
You got in my way, Krill.
Lash, your ego will be your undoing.
I was hoping for so much more out of you, Lash.
If I wanted to listen to arrogant twats I'd go to Washington.
A shame they couldn't conjure up talent.
It's ok, Ava, no one's going to turn you into a rabbit anymore.
Sinclair was out of their league.
Nashala isn't getting what she paid for…
I wish all my targets had you for a bodyguard…
Good to know that the Djinn can't afford decent help.
I probably did her a favor.
Better to die at my hand than whatever the lich has planned for her.
I'm not going to worry about the hand, that's Graves' problem not mine.
Always a pleasure seeing you again Raven
The Soviet Empire isn't going to be pleased with me
Oh Raven, when will you learn…
The Baxter Society will morn him. As will I.
You're a relic of a bygone era, Talon.
Join Wesley in the retirement home, Venator.
That's the best the Vatican could muster?
I expected so much more of you, Venator.
You're out of your depth father.
We get it, Billy, you're very angry.
And so goes another American intellectual.
I'm not getting killed by an idiot with a goat head.
You may not be able to fight, but at least you have style.
He won't last in the Society…
You're the best Wesley could find?
Love your hair by the way.
If I didn’t kill him the Baxter Society would have eventually…
And now I'm fighting some sea tyrant, lovely
Pocket, just go home to your trust fund.
I love tying up lose ends.
I'm sure Maximillian will have questions…
I don't see why Mendoza couldn't stop her…
I won't let you get in my way, Ivy.
Ivy, you're not used to fighting a higher class of criminal.
You aren't ready to fight someone like me, Ivy.
He died as irrelevantly as he lived
You had no business being out here
You were never going to survive the Maelstrom, Trapper
I feel like I just lowered my self…
She might be the gaudiest practitioner of magic I've ever seen.
Too much glitter, Celeste, too much glitter.
Your dress is gorgeous by the way.
A shame, I was a fan of her work.
A shame the Patrons pitted us against each other, Mina.
There's nothing worse than a criminal without standards…
I'm amazed she wasn't in jail.
Viscous won't be a problem for a while.
The Deep should have chosen a more competent emissary.
Warden, one day you'll understand the cost of blind loyalty…
Warden won't be hassling us for a bit…
Don't you have some bar to run off to, Silver?
Darling, if you thought you could collect the bounty on me, you are sorely mistaken.
Are you ok, Ava? Did the werewolf hurt you?
Silver, you are not at my level, you will never be at my level, and the sooner you stop trying to make a name for yourself, the better it will be for everyone.
Sorry it had to go this way, Wraith…
And here I hoped we could be friends…
A pity you tried to fight me, Wraith.
Wraith we could have had so much fun together…
You can take the girl out of the Baxter Society…
Did that mean creature try to eat you Ava? It's ok, mommy killed it.
The 7th Moon's time is coming to an end.
Yamato, you may be deadly but you're not me.
You have power, Yamato… you just don't know what to do with it.
I could kill them all day…
I don't know what people are talking about, subjugating your enemies is rather easy, isn't it?
Welcome to the age of Calico.
This will go so much easier if you just accept your fate.
And this is what success looks like.
I hold myself to the highest standards.
This is even easier than I expected.
Hm. I thought they'd put up a fight, I guess I can be wrong.
They really are rather pathetic, aren't they?
The time's come to complete the ritual.
If you want something done right…
I have no time to lollygag.
Perhaps now's not the best time to fight.

Detective, I'm very good at my job and I assume that between the two of us we should have little trouble dispatching our enemies. But if things go wrong, then yes, I am absolutely going to leave you to die.
I see we're not letting the truth get in the way of a good story, are we Detective.
Honest men are hard to come by. They tend to stick out even if they weren't a blue wall of muscle.
You're a good little boy that does what he's told aren't you
If you're half as good as people say you are you should be working as an assassin, not a pit fighter.
But your perfectly fine putting people in the hospital for money.
You look like you haven't aged a day.
You need to tell me your secret.
I suppose it is a bit of a reunion of sorts.
If something happens to me can you take care of Ava?
I'm not with the Baxter Society anymore.
Here to torment the Jeffries family?
I don't care. Touch my cat, and she'll be eating you.
After the ritual, you will tell me everything.
Of course you do, she's fabulous.
Why wouldn't he say that, he has power and wants to keep people in line.
I'd like to meet your father.
That's why I'm asking you to facilitate the introduction.
Risk? I'm a great person to know.
A perfectly reasonable concern. Hopefully you'll see things differently after today.
I didn't realize I was supposed to take orders from you.
Ava… be nice to the paranoid corpse for mommy.
Like hypothetically if part of you belonged to someone I murdered would that be a problem?
It's not like I can see your legs how should I know.
That wasn't a question, I'm telling you that you need my help.
Speak to me after the ritual… you're in more danger than you know.
Don't worry about us, Sheriff - we'll be fine.
Enough to know to stay away from it.
You're not much of a talker, are you.
God, you and Wesley would get along famously.
Professor, you've spent time at the Black Chateau correct?
It's my job to keep abreast of interesting people.
Your wife's name is Marla, correct?
You don't need to worry about that now, we have bigger problems.
Yes, I'm exactly who you think I am. No I don't feel bad about leaving the Baxter Society. Killing people for money is insanely lucrative. I sleep well at night. Her name is Ava.
I have one of those faces.
I assume subtlety isn't your thing?
No, but I'm very familiar with you
You have nothing to worry about today.
You know, after I finished my first contract killing, I celebrated by buying one of your late husband's paintings.
Well know that it has gone to a loving home.
Oh, I'll probably stay a couple extra nights before heading home. Why do you ask?
What a kind offer, I'd love to.
That is kind of you to say.
I see we like to travel inconspicuously….
If I cared what they thought I wouldn't have left, now would I?
Don't we make for a splendid pair of Judas's
Come now, it's just us girls, you can be honest.
Do you know who I am?
Do you want to talk about it, or is this just going to be awkward.
What would Marlowe say if he saw us right now?
You're a fun one, I like you.
Hope you put up more of a fight than the last Sandman I met on the job.
I suppose I will, won't I.
Hey Vindicta, would you mind doing me a favor?

No ones taking contracts out on members of the Friends of Humanity because they know if they wait long enough you'll just kill them for free. Would you mind easing up a bit and leaving some for the rest of us.
We go back a long ways, don't we Ava.
Who wouldn't be, I'm incredibly charming.
You don't look happy to work with me
You don't know anything about my life.
Is this the part where you try to coax me back to the light.
I'm not interested in your judgement or your pity.
Oh don't worry about Ava, she'll be fine.
Kelvin, may I ask you a question?
You're not as sanctimonious as you are in your book are you?
Oh, look the ritual's starting, let's chat later.
I hope you boys have been staying out of trouble?
I'm grateful that our interests align today.
Thank you for taking care of -
No one could prevent today from happening.
You flatter her, but she does doesn’t she.
And you're the boorish pit fighter.
That's surprisingly clever Lash, I didn't think you had that in you.
Oh I don't know about that, I imagine yours is a rather shallow pool
Most people I fight end up dead, so it's a reasonable hypothesis
That assumes you're able to keep up with me
No, I left a job that wasn't paying me what I was worth.
I also used to not have a yacht and now I do, what's your point?
Well it's a wonderful city, if you want to go to a museum or something after we kill everyone let me know.
I choose to take that as a compliment.
I feel like I've seen you before.
I know what it is, you were at the summit in Cologne last year.
Sigfreid was allegedly assassinated; there were no witnesses so who knows, maybe he slit his throat shaving.
I'm sorry I didn't come to the funeral, it didn't seem appropriate for me to -
How awkward is this going to be?
Can we get the lecture over with?
Please, I didn't betray you. You weren't even in the Baxter Society before my departure.
"our name"? Shiv, pretend all you like but you'll never be one of them.
So who had you pay The Price? Wesley?
Ugh. Mira Al-din, that's a lady who might have to have an accident soon.
Yes, yes, loyalty and all that. Look, I'm just saying, that woman is terrible.
Look at you turning a new leaf.
Please, I haven't changed, I've just recognized my value.
I shot you, I didn't try to kill you.
Yes. I'm not that good, you're just that lucky.
I'm not the person you need to be worried about
God, I didn't murder your parents in front of you did I.
I went to a lot of parties.
That’s right, I killed one of their clients before dessert. Small world.
I mean it is a terrible idea, but who am I to get in the way of someone's self destruction.
What, so you never talk to your fellow Venators?
You have no moral high ground.
You assume that the people I kill are innocent.
Oh come on, we worked well together.
I'm a multifaceted individual, Father. I'm allowed to show affection.
Cover your ears Ava, the bad man has no idea what he's talking about
I know people who would pay a lot of money for that horn of yours.
I'm just trying to make conversation, no need to be rude.
I don’t know how you do it.
I'm not talking about your act, I'm talking about you coming home covered in glitter, it's wretched stuff.
Wine tasting. I'm working on my sommelier certification.
Fashion week wasn't kind to you last year.
Mina, could you design me a dress?
I think I can manage, yes.
I think we met at a Kelsey Evans party a few years ago.
Right, well you weren’t missing much, but nice to meet you again.
I kill people for money. You kill people for a pack of cigarettes and a hot meal, we're not the same.
No I'm sounding a lot classist because I'm nothing like you.
I didn't realize my exploits were things of New Jersey lore.

Vyper, there are some who may find your pathetic nature endearing. I am not one of them. So let me lay down ground rules. If you touch my cat, I'll take your hand. If you hurt my cat, I'll kill you. And if for some pruno addled reason you decide that it's a good idea to steal my cat, you will pray for a death that will not come.
You track down delinquents, I kill heads of state. The venn diagram isn't exactly a circle.
Ignore her Ava, she's an idiot.
Contract killing pays better than bounty hunting, you know.
There's not much of a difference.
Oh come on, how often do you take the "or alive" part seriously?
If the 7th Moon ever needs assistance, my rates are rather reasonable
That sounded less like a question and more like an order.
People seem to be afraid of you.
I think I'm going to like working you.
You have no idea how far out of your league you are…
I don't like the odds here…
The numbers aren't in my favor.
I never say no to money.
I won't leave this lying around.
The Rejuvenator's in hand, what's our plan?
It wasn’t supposed to go this way…
Are we going to just leave the souls lying there?
It's important to surround yourself with disposable, I mean good, people.
It was smart to ask for my help.
I always get what I want… you'll see.
Let's get this show on the road, shall we?
What better way to show off my product than to kill a God?
My my, what a lovely group of miscreants we have.
It's about time someone adds some class around here.
I think you'll find I'm perfectly agreeable as long as you do what I say.
I need to get to the curiosity shop…
I should see what I can afford at the shop.
Might be time to improve my gear.
I can get something of quality…
I can't spend this when I'm dead.
And like that we are closer to victory.
Oh look, they think they're making a difference…
The ritual will be completed soon.
I have business to attend to.
Might as well catalogue the items for next week's auction.
Take a good look at what a fool looks like, Ava…
You don't expect me to sit around and wait for you to come to your senses, do you?
It's like I told my son: you are free to make all the horrible decisions you'd like.
I would have handed you victory.
Some of my favorite tools of the trade.
Taking their lives will be easy.
I'll do my best to make it quick.
Not everything needs to be subtle.
Time to show off my wares.
I'm going to put my fist through their skull.
I'm ready to get my hands dirty.
Why stop at metaphorical blood on my hands?
I will leave a bloody trail in my wake.
Ready to get in the mix.
Oh this is going to be fun.
Their blood will stain my hands.
Ava darling, are you ready to get to work?
What would I do without you, Ava?
No time to make biscuits today, Ava, we have work to do.
Thanks for joining mommy at her job, Ava.
I'll always invest in you, my dear.
You never let me down, Ava.
I can always rely on Ava.
I always have an escape route.
I decide when and where I strike.
The Baxter Society has given me many gifts.
There's no situation I can't get out of.
My timing needs to be perfect.
There's a reason I'm hard to catch.
If Interpol hasn't caught me what chance do they have?
Let's try that again, shall we?
I have more tricks up my sleeve…
I'm not finished with you yet…
Let's see them try to shoot me…
Darling, you don't have a chance.
I'll be the last thing you see.
I'm ready to have some fun…
Let's go for a walk, Ava…
Let's see if they prepared for this.
The streets are mine to prowl.
Let's go for a little stroll.
The shadows call, and I answer…
The shadows are my sword and shield.
That was never going to work on me…
Their tricks won't work on me…
Their life will sustain my own.
Grey Talon, I can heal you!
I look forward to next time.
I'm not ready for a team fight
Check out what Grey Talon bought.
You all were lovely to work with.
I don't suppose any of you want to go to tomorrow's matinee of South Pacific? I have an extra ticket.
It was a pleasure doing business with you.
I'm sure our paths will cross again.
Ava, take a look at all the lovely people we're about to murder.
So are all of you contract killers or am I just going to be a lion amongst the lambs?
God I love visiting New York.
Well, Ava, what do you say we go summon an elder god?
I always forged my own path, but today I write my own destiny.
I have waited for this day for far too long.
I'm ready for a team fight.
I'll turn the shadows to my advantage.
I'm ready to avoid their blows.
I'm ready to spring the trap.
